executables.description: [stable] Globs (bundle paths) of files that get mode 755; every other file is 644. The argv[0] of every native exec is executable too. Modes never come from the build host's filesystem.

platform_files.description: [beta] Glob (bundle path) -> the platforms or OSes whose nodes receive the matching files; a file matched by several globs goes to each one's platforms, and unmatched files go everywhere. The coordinator and the CLI always have the whole bundle. Needs requires.core >= 2.2.
platform_files.title: Platform Files

exec.description: [beta] Module CLI; `oarbank cli <module> ...` runs it on the coordinator, sandboxed, with a token scoped to the module (OARBANKD_URL, OARBANK_TOKEN).

direction.description: Which way is better; enables best/colouring generically.

platform.description: [beta] OCI platform (open set), e.g. linux/arm64 or linux/amd64 (emulated where the node's arch differs).

files.description: [beta] A path prefix in the module's files ('' = all of them).

Placement.description:
Keeps each unit of work on one platform class while other units use other classes (spec/platforms.md,
"Placement"). Absent: mix `any`, today's behaviour. [beta]

bind.description: [beta] How a unit gets its class: `capacity` (the feasible class with the most free certified CPU, at creation), `first-claim` (the class of the first node that claims one of its jobs) or `explicit` (only a pin). Absent: `capacity` for campaigns, `first-claim` otherwise.
bind.title: Bind

mix.description: [beta] Open set: `any`, `same-os`, `same-arch` or `same-platform`. An unknown value applies as `same-platform` (fail safe) and `oarbank-sdk check` warns.
mix.title: Mix

rebind.description: [beta] When no node of the bound class has been eligible for `stranded_after_s`: `never` raises an alert naming the remedy; `if-stranded` rebinds to the best feasible class and re-queues the unit's finished jobs.
rebind.title: Rebind

stranded_after_s.description: [beta] Seconds before a bound unit counts as stranded.
stranded_after_s.title: Stranded After S

unit.description: [beta] What stays together: a campaign, a job group within a campaign (jobs.enqueue `group`), the jobs of one dataset within a campaign, or one pipeline (head and tail stages, replicas and tie-breaks).
unit.title: Unit

Placement.title: Placement

platforms.description: [beta] Only on these platforms (empty: every declared platform).
platforms.title: Platforms

A core refuses to install or enable the module on a coordinator host not listed, and blocks a coordinator move to one. Needs requires.core >= 2.2.
coordinator_platforms.title: Coordinator Platforms

experimental.description: [stable] Opt-ins to experimental contract items; any opt-in blocks the verified badge.

features.description: [beta] Must-understand list: a reader that does not know a listed feature refuses the manifest. Known: `placement`. Needs requires.core >= 2.2.

module_protocol.description: [stable] Module protocol majors the coordinator side speaks.

os.description: [stable] Supported OS versions per OS (only for the declared platforms).

platforms.title: Platforms

runner_protocol.description: [stable] Runner protocol majors the runner speaks.
runner_protocol.title: Runner Protocol

service_protocol.description: [stable] Service protocol majors (only when services/probes are declared).
service_protocol.title: Service Protocol

ui_contract.description: [beta] UI contract versions the module's pages use, e.g. '>=1.0,<2' (spec/ui-contract.md).
ui_contract.title: Ui Contract

unsupported.description: [beta] Why the module does not run somewhere, shown by explain and the console. Needs requires.core >= 2.2.

mem_gb.description: [stable] Peak memory (GB) the job may use; the agent budgets it before admission.

cpu.description: [beta] Replaces the stage's cpu on this platform.

mem_gb.description: [beta] Replaces the stage's mem_gb on this platform.
mem_gb.title: Mem Gb

indexed.description: [stable] Promote to a generated column with an index (sortable/filterable).
indexed.title: Indexed

determinism.title: Determinism

An unknown scope compares within one platform.

schema.description: [stable] JSON Schema (bundle path) for the result payload.

max_attempts.description: [stable] Execution attempts before the job is quarantined.

bandwidth_class.description: [experimental] Measured memory-bandwidth appetite relative to the node's memory system (measured on Apple unified memory so far).
bandwidth_class.title: Bandwidth Class

env.description: [beta] Extra environment for the runner and doctor, applied after the agent's own variables (names `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`, never OARBANK_* or another reserved name), e.g. MKL_CBWR or OMP_NUM_THREADS for determinism. Needs requires.core >= 2.2.
env.title: Env

exec.description: [stable] argv (spec/manifest.md, "Exec"); the agent appends `run --spec S --workdir W --out R [--events E]` or `doctor --json`.
exec.title: Exec

stop_grace_s.description: [stable] Seconds between the stop request and forced termination of the process container.
stop_grace_s.title: Stop Grace S

variants.description: [beta] Per-platform overrides, keyed by platform token (`linux-amd64`) or OS (`linux`).
variants.title: Variants

env.title: Env

kind.description: [stable] Open set. `python`: the host's managed CPython with the SDK (plus the bundle's requirements, installed from wheels); `uv`: a locked uv project (wheels only, resolvable for every declared platform) built offline into a per-module environment; `native`: argv[0] is a native executable in the bundle (Mach-O, ELF or PE, or a POSIX shebang script in darwin/linux variants). An unknown kind means the entry point cannot run on this node.

lock.description: [stable] Path of uv.lock inside the bundle (kind=uv).

python.description: [stable] Exact Python version for the venv (kind=uv), e.g. 3.12.14.

gpu.description: [beta] Open set: `none` or `compute` (GPU compute through the platform's APIs, no display server; weakens isolation, so it is flagged at approval).

allow.title: Allow

mode.description: [beta] Open set. `none`; `egress-allowlist`: only the `allow` hosts, through the agent's local proxy (the SDK sets HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY); `egress-any`: any public address, a separately approved full-trust grant. Never loopback or link-local, never listening.
mode.title: Mode

What the module's node-side processes (runner, services, probes) need beyond their bundle, runtime, data and work
directories (spec/sandbox.md). Every request is shown to an operator, who approves it for each module version before
that version can run. The coordinator side never gets these grants. [beta]

exec_writable.description: [beta] Runners may execute files they wrote into the data or work directory (downloaded tools). Not enforceable as `false` on Windows without application control; nodes report it.

tools.description: [beta] Host tools (registry ids) runners may read and execute.
tools.title: Tools

needs_pools.description: [beta] Pools that must exist on the node but are not reserved (a short phase uses them).
